content:
aria: Heads up — main is red after the merge that went in ~10m ago. smoke job failing consistently on allocator test :grimacing:
ci-bot: Build 8772 failed — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/8772 (smoke/smoke-gpu). Log: `ERROR: tests/test_allocator_smoke.py::test_basic_alloc`
sam: I'll grab the logs and try a local reproduce. quick paste of failing snippet:
```
FAIL tests/test_allocator_smoke.py::test_basic_alloc
E   AssertionError: Expected free_mem_percent > 0.01
E   GPU0 free: 0.0, expected > 0.01
Alloc trace: alloc(128MB) -> OOM on GPU0
```
lee: tia — PR 2567 (simd quant + allocator tweak) landed just before this. It touched the low-level fallback paths, could be related.
maria: last green on main was commit 0f9c3a2 (1774298000). PR2567 was merged right after that. We should bisect between 0f9c3a2 and HEAD.
aria: can someone run `git bisect`? if it's a perf/regression in allocator heuristics we might need a quick revert.
sam: starting a bisect now on my laptop, will try to run the smoke job locally across candidates. will post results in ~20m.
ci-bot: Note: retrying the same CI job (rerun) shows the same failure 3/3 — not flaky at glance.
devops: if we revert, remember to also rollback the canary config in dedicated clusters (PR2567 changed kernel flags)
sam: bisect narrowed it down — culprit commit looks like `a3b7c9f` from PR2567 (changed fallback allocation logic). reproduces locally with `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --gpu`
aria: thanks — can you post a minimal repro command and the failing stacktrace? we'll draft a revert PR and fast-track it.
sam: repro: `python -m pytest tests/test_allocator_smoke.py::test_basic_alloc -q -k smoke` on `a3b7c9f` -> fails, on parent commit passes. Stacktrace attached in build logs.
maria: I'll open a revert PR now (revert PR2567), link it here and add urgent label. @devops can you queue the hotfix pipeline if we merge revert?
devops: yes, will stand by. If revert merges, I'll promote hotfix to prod queues and watch telemetry.
lee: follow-up: after revert we should add a focused unit that asserts free_mem_percent > 0.01 on CI to catch this earlier.
aria: plan summary: 1) revert PR2567 (maria) 2) merge + hotfix pipeline (devops) 3) run smoke on dedicated + hosted (ci-bot) 4) open root-cause fix branch and don't re-merge until green (sam/lee)
sam: on it, opening bisect notes gist and the revert PR in 5m. will ping here when done. :thumbsup:
aria: thanks all — appreciate fast reactions. keep updates in this thread so oncall handoff stays smooth. :white_check_mark:
